cards.text: David, king of Israel, has just made his son Solomon king (1 Kings 1:39), and now the time is drawing near for David to die. He charges Solomon: "I am about to go the way of all the earth. So be strong and prove yourself a man."

cards.question: Along with being strong, what else does David charge his son Solomon to do?
David tells Solomon to keep God's commands as written in the Law of Moses, so that he may ___ in all he does and wherever he turns.

cards.text: David says it's also so the LORD may fulfill a promise He made to David himself. No pressure on Solomon. NONE at all.

cards.question: What did the LORD promise David?

answers.text: A man of his line on Israel's throne
A palace that would never fall
Peace with every nation around him

cards.question: True or false: The LORD's promise to David held no matter how David's descendants lived.

cards.text: Then David brings up Joab son of Zeruiah, commander of the army. David says Joab killed Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether, two commanders of Israel's armies, in peacetime to avenge the blood of war.

cards.question: David says Joab stained his belt and sandals with the blood of war. Then he tells Solomon to act according to his wisdom. What should Solomon do about Joab?

answers.text: Not let him die in peace

cards.text: FINALLY, a name on David's list you'd actually WANT to be on: the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite. They stood by David when he fled from Solomon's brother Absalom.

cards.question: David tells Solomon to show ___ to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite.
True or false: David wants Barzillai's sons to be among those who eat at Solomon's table.

cards.text: When I got called out of that junk drawer, my whole goodbye fit on the back of one takeout menu, and David's has a SECOND PAGE. Next, David tells Solomon to keep an eye on Shimei son of Gera, a Benjamite from Bahurim.
Shimei called down bitter curses against David the day David went to Mahanaim. Bitter curses at the KING, and friend, I can't even talk back to an oven timer.

cards.question: True or false: When Shimei came down to meet David at the Jordan, David swore to him by the LORD never to put him to the sword.
David tells Solomon he's a wise man who will know what to do with Shimei. What does David want for Shimei's gray head?

answers.text: Brought down to Sheol in blood
Left to go down in peace

cards.text: David's charge to his son is done. Then David rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David.

cards.question: David reigned over Israel for forty years: seven years in Hebron and ___ years in Jerusalem.

cards.text: Solomon sits on the throne of his father David, and his kingdom is firmly established. Don't untie your apron yet, friend, because this story's still in the oven.
